repos.name: 05_Audiobook_Generation
repos.summary: Audiobook Generation System converts long documents (EPUB/PDF/TXT/Markdown) into mastered audiobooks with chaptering, text normalization, neural TTS synthesis, and agentic pipeline orchestration. It includes a trainable text-normalization model, neural TTS backend (SpeechT5), and deterministic agent for document processing.

repos.name: 3D_Software_and_Python
repos.summary: The repository provides example Python scripts for Autodesk 3D Studio Max, Maya, and Blender that demonstrate how to use the Python API to create similar scenes across these applications. It includes functions for preparing scenes, importing and animating meshes, creating geometry from vertex data, handling hierarchies and animations, and assigning materials. All scripts come with simple GUIs and are designed to show basic usage of Python in 3D software.

repos.name: 9router
repos.summary: 9Router is an AI router that connects coding tools like Claude Code, Cursor, Copilot, and others to 40+ AI providers and 100+ models, enabling unlimited free AI coding with auto-fallback and token savings. It provides a dashboard for managing providers and supports multiple CLI tools through a single endpoint.

repos.name: A2A
repos.summary: Agent2Agent (A2A) is an open protocol enabling communication and interoperability between opaque agentic applications. It allows AI agents built on diverse frameworks to discover each other's capabilities, negotiate interaction modalities, and securely collaborate on complex tasks without exposing internal state or tools. The protocol supports standardized JSON-RPC 2.0 over HTTP(S) with flexible interaction methods including synchronous request/response, streaming (SSE), and asynchronous push notifications.

repos.name: a2a-inspector
repos.summary: The A2A Inspector is a web-based tool that allows developers to inspect, debug, and validate servers implementing the A2A (Agent2Agent) protocol. It provides a user-friendly interface to connect to A2A agents, view agent cards, perform specification compliance checks, and monitor communication via live chat and a debug console.

repos.name: a2a-js
repos.summary: The A2A JavaScript SDK provides a TypeScript/JavaScript implementation of the Agent2Agent (A2A) Protocol specification v1.0.0, enabling developers to build A2A servers that expose agent capabilities over multiple transports and A2A clients that discover and interact with those agents. It supports three wire transports (JSON-RPC, HTTP+JSON/REST, gRPC), includes backward compatibility with v0.3 peers, and provides tools for streaming tasks, task cancellation, and push notifications.

repos.name: a2a-python
repos.summary: The A2A Python SDK provides a library for building and running agentic applications that comply with the Agent2Agent (A2A) Protocol, enabling communication between agents using multiple transport methods including JSON-RPC, HTTP/REST, and gRPC. It supports asynchronous operations and offers optional integrations with databases, web frameworks like FastAPI, and observability tools such as OpenTelemetry.

repos.name: aar-loop
repos.summary: The repository implements a manual Reflexion loop based on the US Army's 4-question After Action Review (AAR) method to help AI agents learn from sessions and avoid repeating mistakes. It guides users through reviewing sessions, identifying issues, writing concrete lessons, and applying fixes to skills or rules files. The system compiles lessons into a persistent LESSONS.md file that can be loaded by future sessions.

repos.name: aauto-sdk-1
repos.summary: An unofficial Android Auto SDK that provides access to Android Auto's projection, service, and notification capabilities, along with sensor data and vendor channel communication for car-specific protocols. It enables developers to create Android Auto applications that can interact with vehicle systems and hardware.

repos.name: academic-research-skills
repos.summary: Academic Research Skills provides a suite of Claude Code skills for managing the complete academic research pipeline from initial research through final publication, including literature review, writing assistance, citation management, and peer review support. It offers tools for planning paper structure via Socratic dialogue, conducting literature reviews, generating academic content, and performing quality checks on references and claims. The system emphasizes human-in-the-loop collaboration to avoid AI-generated research pitfalls while automating routine tasks.

repos.name: activepieces
repos.summary: Activepieces is an open source workflow automation platform that serves as a replacement for Zapier, enabling users to create AI-powered workflows and integrations with over 200 services. It provides a type-safe pieces framework in TypeScript that supports AI agents, MCP servers, and AI workflow automation with support for Claude Desktop, Cursor, and Windsurf.

repos.name: adk-docs
repos.summary: Agent Development Kit (ADK) is an open-source, code-first toolkit for building, evaluating, and deploying sophisticated AI agents with flexibility and control. It provides a modular framework optimized for Gemini and the Google ecosystem but is model-agnostic and deployment-agnostic. The toolkit supports rich tool ecosystems, code-first development, modular multi-agent systems, tracing and monitoring, and seamless deployment across various platforms.

repos.name: adk-go
repos.summary: An open-source, code-first Go toolkit for building, evaluating, and deploying sophisticated AI agents with flexibility and control. It provides a modular framework for creating AI agents that can be orchestrated and deployed in cloud-native environments.

repos.name: adk-java
repos.summary: An open-source, code-first Java toolkit for building, evaluating, and deploying sophisticated AI agents with flexibility and control, designed for developers seeking fine-grained control when building advanced AI agents integrated with Google Cloud services.

repos.name: adk-js
repos.summary: An open-source, code-first TypeScript toolkit for building, evaluating, and deploying sophisticated AI agents with flexibility and control. It provides a modular framework for defining agent behavior, orchestration, and tool use directly in code, enabling robust debugging, versioning, and deployment anywhere.

repos.name: adk-kotlin
repos.summary: The Agent Development Kit (ADK) for Kotlin provides a code-first toolkit for building, evaluating, and deploying sophisticated AI agents with flexibility and control, supporting both on-device and cloud execution environments. It enables developers to define agent behavior, orchestration, and tool use directly in Kotlin for robust debugging, versioning, and deployment across various platforms.

repos.name: adk-python
repos.summary: An open-source, code-first Python toolkit for building, evaluating, and deploying sophisticated AI agents with flexibility and control. It provides a graph-based execution engine for composing deterministic agent workflows, structured task delegation, modular multi-agent systems, and rich tool integration capabilities.

repos.name: adk-samples
repos.summary: A collection of sample agents built with the Agent Development Kit (ADK) that demonstrate how to solve real problems using ADK patterns. It includes canonical recipes curated by the agents-cli team and community-contributed recipes for specific use cases or workflows.

repos.name: adk_cloud_run
repos.summary: This repository provides a sample setup of Google ADK (Agent Development Kit) configured for containerization with Docker and deployment to Google Cloud Run. It includes a multi-tool agent implementation ready to be run locally or deployed via gcloud CLI. The setup supports local execution using 'adk run' and 'adk web' commands, and can be deployed to Cloud Run with specific environment variables.

repos.name: adrflow
repos.summary: ADRFlow is an MCP server that captures architectural decisions made while coding, automatically detecting and recording them during AI-assisted development. It allows users to search, filter, and export these decisions for documentation and future reference. The tool integrates with AI coding assistants like Claude Code, Cursor, Windsurf, and Codex to provide context-aware decision logging.

repos.name: af-deep-research
repos.summary: AF Deep Research provides an autonomous AI backend that performs deep research by spawning parallel agents to explore queries from multiple angles, evaluating findings against quality thresholds, generating new sub-queries when gaps are detected, and running iterative cycles until a quality threshold is met. It returns structured research packages with entities, relationships, evidence, and cited documents.

repos.name: AFFiNE
repos.summary: AFFiNE is a next-gen knowledge base that combines planning, sorting, and creating in one platform. It offers a merged canvas for docs, whiteboards, and databases with real-time collaboration and local-first data ownership. The platform supports multimodal AI integration and provides tools for creative organization and knowledge management.

repos.name: afx-nuke-plugins
repos.summary: Provides a collection of compositing plugins for Nuke including glow, soft clip, tone mapping, median filtering, chroma keying, despill, and anti-aliasing effects. The plugins offer enhanced functionality and performance compared to Nuke's native tools, with some utilizing CUDA and Intel IPP for accelerated processing.

repos.name: agency-agents
repos.summary: A collection of specialized AI agent personalities designed for specific workflows in software engineering, design, paid media, and sales domains. Each agent provides expert-level capabilities with defined processes, deliverables, and communication styles tailored to particular tasks.

repos.name: agency-swarm
repos.summary: Agency Swarm is a framework for building multi-agent applications that leverages the OpenAI Agents SDK to create, orchestrate, and manage collaborative swarms of AI agents with customizable roles, tools, and communication flows.

repos.name: agent-beacon
repos.summary: Beacon captures agent session history across multiple coding harnesses like Claude Code, Cursor, Codex, and OpenCode, normalizing this data into a shared event model that makes useful workflows, corrections, and debugging patterns reusable by future agents. It provides local-first storage with optional forwarding to SIEM and log aggregation tools.

repos.name: agent-desktop
repos.summary: Native desktop automation CLI for AI agents that controls any application through OS accessibility trees with structured JSON output and deterministic element references. It provides observation, interaction, keyboard, mouse, notification, clipboard, window management, session lifecycle, trace read/export capabilities, and supports progressive skeleton traversal for token-efficient AI workflows.

repos.name: agent-framework
repos.summary: A framework for building, orchestrating, and deploying AI agents and multi-agent workflows with support for Python and .NET. It provides tools for creating production-grade agents with features like orchestration patterns, middleware, observability, and provider flexibility.

repos.name: agent-kernel
repos.summary: Provides a minimal kernel to make AI coding agents stateful by using three markdown files and a git repository for memory management. It allows agents to remember past sessions, take notes, and build on previous work without requiring databases or custom frameworks.

repos.name: agent-lightning
repos.summary: Agent Lightning is a lightweight agentic reinforcement learning framework that enables training AI agents using real harnesses with minimal code changes. It provides components for training, API gateway proxying, and rollout control to facilitate agent development and evaluation across multiple domains including coding, search, and sandbox environments.

repos.name: agent-os
repos.summary: Agent OS is a system designed to extract coding standards and conventions from an existing codebase, then intelligently apply these standards to guide AI agents in generating better specifications and code that aligns with the project's established patterns.

repos.name: agent-plugins-spec
repos.summary: Agent Plugins is an open, vendor-neutral standard for packaging reusable components that extend AI agents into distributable plugins. It defines a portable package format for Agent Skills and MCP servers.

repos.name: agent-search
repos.summary: AgentSearch provides a Python framework for building and deploying search agents that can perform customizable local searches, likely involving information retrieval and processing.

repos.name: agent-second-brain
repos.summary: This repository provides a system that processes voice notes sent via Telegram, organizes them into a knowledge base with persistent memory, generates tasks in Todoist, and creates daily reports. It incorporates an Ebbinghaus decay model for memory and a knowledge graph.

repos.name: agent-starter-react
repos.summary: A complete voice AI frontend app for LiveKit Agents with Next.js

repos.name: agent-toolkit-for-aws
repos.summary: The Agent Toolkit for AWS provides official AWS-supported MCP servers, skills, and plugins to help AI agents build, deploy, and manage applications on AWS. It includes core AWS capabilities, agent-specific tools for Bedrock and AgentCore, data analytics workflows, and DevOps security tools. The toolkit enables agents to interact with AWS services through the Model Context Protocol, execute scripts in sandboxed environments, and access real-time documentation.

repos.name: agent-zero
repos.summary: Agent Zero provides an open agent framework that gives AI agents access to a full Linux desktop environment within Docker, including browser capabilities with DOM annotation, live document collaboration, project management, and plugin support. It enables agents to perform complex tasks involving GUI software, web browsing, document editing, and system interactions through a web-based interface.

repos.name: agent_hub
repos.summary: Bitget Agent Hub is Bitget's official AI Agent toolkit, covering cryptocurrency and tokenized US stock trading — bringing 89 Bitget UTA v3 operations across trading and market analysis to Claude, Cursor, Codex, ChatGPT, and other AI agents.

repos.name: agentfield
repos.summary: AgentField provides a control plane for building, running, and scaling AI agents as production-ready microservices. It enables developers to write agent logic in Python, Go, or TypeScript and exposes them as REST APIs that can handle fan-out execution to thousands of parallel agents. The system manages routing, coordination, memory, async execution, and observability.

repos.name: agentic-ai-apis
repos.summary: The repository provides a curated collection of 2,977 production-ready APIs for building autonomous AI agents, organized into three main categories: Agents for execution and orchestration, AI Models for inference and generation, and MCP Servers for tool integrations. It serves as a launchpad for developers to quickly find and implement API layers needed for agentic AI systems.

repos.name: agentic-awesome-skills
repos.summary: AAS Core provides a local, agent-first control plane for discovering, selecting, and validating agentic skills from a catalog of over 2,000 skills. It supports agent-owned skill composition through a read-only MCP interface, validates selections in memory, and produces immutable stack manifests and plans. The system enables human review of agent-selected stacks via CLI validation and browser-based Workbench.

repos.name: agentic-flow
repos.summary: Agentic-Flow provides production-ready AI agent orchestration with 66 self-learning agents, 213 MCP tools, and autonomous multi-agent swarms. It enables switching between alternative low-cost AI models in Claude Code/Agent SDK and deploys hosted agents for business use cases. The system includes SONA for adaptive learning, AgentDB for memory optimization, and advanced attention mechanisms for improved performance.

repos.name: agentic-robots-txt
repos.summary: This repository specifies a protocol, Agentic_Robots.txt, that extends the traditional robots.txt to define rules and capabilities for autonomous agents interacting with web applications, including agent-specific directives and API interaction guidelines.

repos.name: agentic-sdlc-handbook
repos.summary: This repository provides a comprehensive guide, the 'Agentic SDLC Handbook,' designed for both C-suite executives and practitioners, detailing how to integrate AI agents into the Software Development Life Cycle.

repos.name: agentic-security
repos.summary: This repository provides an 'Agentic Security Scanner' framework, likely implementing AI agents to automate security scanning tasks.

repos.name: agentic-trading
repos.summary: Demonstrates agent-based trading system simulation with separate agents for trading logic (AlphaBot) and risk management (RiskGuard), communicating via the Agent-to-Agent (A2A) protocol. Includes a web-based simulator UI to configure, run, and visualize trading strategy performance including SMA crossover strategies and portfolio tracking. Features local and cloud deployment options using Docker and Google Cloud Run.

repos.name: agentics-wiki
repos.summary: Provides a placeholder repository that redirects users to the official Agentics Wiki hosted on GitHub, serving as a reference point for documentation about the Agentics project.

repos.name: agenticsorg-starter
repos.summary: This repository provides a starter pack for building autonomous coding agents, specifically designed for 'roo' and 'sparc' frameworks.

repos.name: agentmemory
repos.summary: Provides persistent memory for AI coding agents, allowing them to remember previous interactions and context, reducing the need for re-explanation.

repos.name: agentpool
repos.summary: AgentPool is a unified orchestration hub that allows users to define and manage various AI agents (native, Claude Code, Codex, ACP, AG-UI) via a single YAML configuration, and then exposes them through standardized protocols like ACP and OpenCode Server for inter-agent communication and client access.

repos.name: agentql
repos.summary: AgentQL is a suite of tools that connects AI to the web by enabling data extraction and workflow automation on live websites using natural language queries. It provides Python and JavaScript SDKs, a REST API, and a browser debugger for interacting with elements and extracting data quickly and precisely at scale. The system supports Playwright integrations and works across similar websites with self-healing capabilities.

repos.name: agentrq
repos.summary: AgentRQ is a human-in-loop realtime conversational task manager that enables AI agents to collaborate with human operators through a shared workspace, allowing agents to autonomously manage tasks, update statuses, request permissions, and communicate in real-time via Model Context Protocol (MCP).

repos.name: agents
repos.summary: A framework for building real-time voice AI agents that can see, hear, and understand, supporting conversational multi-modal interactions with flexible integrations for STT, LLM, TTS, and Realtime APIs. It provides tools for building, testing, and deploying voice agents with features like job scheduling, telephony integration, and semantic turn detection.

repos.name: agno
repos.summary: Agno is a framework and runtime for building, running, and managing agent platforms. It provides tools to create agents, deploy them as services, and manage the platform through a web UI. The system supports production APIs, storage solutions, integrations with various tools and platforms, context providers, human approval workflows, observability features, security measures, and multiple deployment options.

repos.name: ai-agents-for-beginners
repos.summary: A comprehensive course teaching beginners how to build AI agents through 12 structured lessons covering agent frameworks, design patterns, tool use, RAG, multi-agent systems, and production deployment. It provides hands-on Python code examples using Microsoft Agent Framework and Foundry services.

repos.name: AI-Audio-Book-Generator
repos.summary: The repository provides an AI-driven audiobook generation system that transforms text, PDF, and Word documents into spoken audio files. It leverages OpenAI GPT for content processing, FastAPI for backend services, Streamlit for the web interface, and Google Text-to-Speech (gTTS) to produce multilingual, customizable narration with downloadable audio output.

repos.name: AI-Audio-Content-Creator
repos.summary: The repository provides an AI-powered platform for creating audio content such as podcasts, narration, and voice generation from text, leveraging modern audio workflows and automation tools.

repos.name: ai-audiobook-generator
repos.summary: The repository provides a production-ready pipeline that transforms markdown lectures into narrated audiobooks using two text-to-speech models: Kokoro and Chatterbox-Turbo. It automates the entire workflow from text processing to audio generation and file packaging.

repos.name: AI-AudioBook-Generator-yaswanthmaddula
repos.summary: The repository provides an AI-powered audiobook generator that converts PDFs, DOCX, and TXT files into narrated audiobooks using Gemini AI, ChromaDB for semantic storage, and text-to-speech (TTS) synthesis. It also includes semantic Q&A support via Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG).

repos.name: ai-audiobook-production-assistant
repos.summary: The repository provides a proof‑of‑concept system that leverages the Claude API to analyze manuscript content, generate narration scripts, and automatically evaluate output fidelity for audiobook production.

repos.name: ai-browser
repos.summary: This repository provides an AI-powered desktop automation agent built as a native desktop application using Electron and Next.js, designed to control a computer like a human user.

repos.name: AI-Context-OS
repos.summary: AI Context OS is a desktop application that transforms a local folder into a universal, tool-agnostic memory layer for AI agents, storing memories, tasks, and rules as plain files with a progressive L0/L1/L2 detail model.

repos.name: ai-dialogue
repos.summary: A universal async AI orchestration protocol that enables sophisticated multi-turn conversations between AI models like Claude and Grok with configurable interaction modes, dynamic workflows, and comprehensive cost tracking. It provides command-line and programmatic interfaces for research, debate, podcast-style teaching, and code generation tasks.

repos.name: ai-employees
repos.summary: AI Employees are open source tools that automate business roles through scheduled routines running on personal machines. Each employee covers a specific business function like GTM engineering, SEO, web development, social media management, ad management, sales, customer satisfaction, or chief of staff. They drive browser activities and improve performance with each run.

repos.name: ai-first-sdlc-practices
repos.summary: A framework for integrating AI agents as primary developers while maintaining quality and process compliance, automating the specify-architect-implement-review workflow with 56 specialist agents across 12 plugins covering AI/ML, full-stack, cloud, security, project management, documentation, and containerised delegation. It provides tools for validating code quality, managing technical debt, and enforcing SDLC compliance through Claude Code integration.

repos.name: ai-job-search
repos.summary: An AI-powered job application framework that evaluates job postings, tailors CVs and cover letters, writes interview prep materials, and manages the entire job search workflow on your local machine using Claude Code.

repos.name: ai-sdlc
repos.summary: AI-SDLC is a declarative governance framework that provides a Decision Engine for spec-driven AI workflows in software development lifecycles. It offers autonomous pipeline orchestration, cross-harness code review, operator terminal user interface, and declarative governance resources to manage AI-augmented development processes with deterministic execution and quality gates.

repos.name: ai-trading-agent-gemini
repos.summary: An AI Trading Agent that analyzes real-time social media sentiment from LunarCrush API and generates actionable trading signals using Google Gemini AI. It features real-time progress tracking, background job processing with Inngest, and live dashboard updates via Supabase subscriptions.

repos.name: ai-video-skill
repos.summary: An AI video skill for end-to-end generation across multiple models with a self-improving quality-control loop.

repos.name: ai-voice-agent-bootstrap
repos.summary: A GPT Realtime-based voice agent bootstrap that enables building a lightweight, realtime customer-satisfaction survey agent with human moderator guidance. It provides a devcontainer-first development environment with backend session management and frontend microphone input handling.

repos.name: AI-Voice-Cloning-SaaS-Starter-File
repos.summary: This repository provides a starter template for building and deploying an AI Voice Cloning SaaS platform using Next.js, Supabase, and AI voice cloning models. It enables users to upload voice samples, clone voices, generate speech, and manage projects within a SaaS dashboard.

repos.name: ai-vook-reader
repos.summary: AI Vook Reader transforms PDF books into emotionally adaptive audiobooks using AI-powered narrative analysis, semantic parsing, and dynamic voice generation. It processes text extraction, story detection, emotion analysis, and generates cinematic narrated audio experiences with subtitle-aware pacing and persistent progress tracking.

repos.name: aider
repos.summary: Aider is an AI pair programming tool that enables users to collaborate with large language models directly in their terminal to build new projects or enhance existing codebases. It integrates with Git for version control, supports multiple programming languages, and works with both cloud and local LLMs.

repos.name: aiogram
repos.summary: aiogram is a modern and fully asynchronous framework for Telegram Bot API written in Python using asyncio and aiohttp. It provides tools to build fast and powerful Telegram bots with support for updates routing, finite state machine, middlewares, and internationalization. The framework integrates with the latest versions of the Telegram Bot API and includes autogenerated code for API integration.

repos.name: AIOS
repos.summary: AIOS is an AI Agent Operating System that embeds large language models into the operating system to facilitate development and deployment of LLM-based AI agents. It provides kernel-level management of resources like LLM, memory, storage, and tools, along with SDK support for agent creation and execution.

repos.name: air
repos.summary: Air is a web framework designed for AI-assisted development that combines FastAPI, Pydantic, and HTMX to enable building web applications with intuitive HTML generation using Python classes or Jinja templates. It provides tools for both AI-generated HTML mockups and direct Python-based HTML construction, supporting both traditional web pages and API endpoints within a single application.

repos.name: airbyte
repos.summary: Airbyte is an open-source data movement platform that enables ELT pipelines and AI agents to transfer data from APIs, databases, and files to warehouses, lakes, and AI applications. It provides a catalog of 600+ connectors and supports both self-hosted and Cloud deployment options. The platform offers tools for building custom connectors and orchestrating data syncs with various workflow engines.

repos.name: airllm
repos.summary: AirLLM enables running large language models up to 2.8T parameters on a single 4GB GPU without quantization, distillation, or pruning. It supports both inference and training of massive models with reduced VRAM requirements through layer-wise decomposition and streaming techniques.

repos.name: aisuite
repos.summary: aisuite provides a unified Python interface for interacting with multiple Generative AI providers including OpenAI, Anthropic, Google, Ollama, and others, with support for chat completions and agent-based tool calling. It includes an Agents API with toolkits for file, git, and shell operations, as well as support for the Model Context Protocol (MCP) to integrate external tools.

repos.name: AiToEarn
repos.summary: AiToEarn is an AI-powered content marketing platform that helps individual creators (OPC), content creators, brands, and enterprises automate content creation, publishing, engagement, and monetization across multiple social media platforms. It provides tools for generating content with AI agents, scheduling posts, automating interactions like likes and comments, and enabling content monetization through various payout models.

repos.name: AL_usd_vscode_extension
repos.summary: This VSCode extension provides syntax highlighting and navigation support for Pixar USD (Universal Scene Description) files, including ASCII syntax highlighting for standard USD types and keywords, navigation via 'usdresolve', and support for binary USDC files through 'usdcat'.

repos.name: AL_USDMaya
repos.summary: AL_USDMaya is a Maya plugin that enables representation of both Maya and USD data within Maya, maintaining live connections between USD and Maya scenes for dynamic synchronization. It allows artists to embed complex Maya assets like rigs into USD scenes and import them back into Maya in their native form, supporting workflows involving scene assembly, animation, and asset resolution.

repos.name: allcontributors.org
repos.summary: The all-contributors.org repository hosts the website and documentation for the All Contributors specification, which recognizes all contributors to open-source projects beyond just code contributions. It provides a specification for acknowledging contributors in project READMEs and offers tools like the @all-contributors bot to automate this recognition. The repository also contains the project's documentation, contribution guidelines, and maintains a list of contributors with their specific roles and contributions.

repos.name: allzpark
repos.summary: Allzpark is a package-based application launcher and environment management tool designed for VFX and games production. It provides both visual and textual interfaces for launching software in a reproducible way, building on the bleeding-rez package manager. The tool supports Windows, Linux, and MacOS platforms with Python 2 or 3 and various Qt bindings.

repos.name: AlphaGPT
repos.summary: AlphaGPT is an open-source automated factor factory based on deep reinforcement learning, designed for financial algorithmic trading. It enables users to build and manage trading strategies using machine learning models. The system includes components for data processing, strategy execution, and performance monitoring.

repos.name: andrej-karpathy-skills
repos.summary: Provides a set of four principles for improving Claude Code behavior when writing code, derived from Andrej Karpathy's observations on LLM coding pitfalls. It offers guidelines to prevent overcomplication, unnecessary changes, and hidden confusion during code generation.

repos.name: Android-Auto-Ultimate-Dev-Unit
repos.summary: Provides a comprehensive guide for setting up Android Auto development environment using emulators on Linux, Mac, or Windows. It walks through installing and configuring phone emulators, head unit emulators, SDK tools, rooting AVDs, installing Android Auto apps through spoofed installers, and configuring various development utilities like King Installer, aa4mg, LSPosed, and Hail for testing Android Auto applications without physical hardware.

repos.name: android-obd-reader
repos.summary: An Android application that reads vehicle diagnostic data using OBD-II protocol through Bluetooth connections to ELM327 adapters. It provides a user interface for viewing vehicle parameters and can upload data to a remote server. The app uses a Java-based OBD library for communication with the vehicle's diagnostic system.

repos.name: android_mcp
repos.summary: Control MCP servers directly from any Android device including phones, tablets, watches, TVs, cars, and other Android-powered hardware. Allow AI to control Android devices as MCP tools for tasks like sending messages, reading notifications, taking photos, and managing apps.

repos.name: animation_nodes
repos.summary: Animation Nodes is a node-based visual scripting system for motion graphics in Blender. It provides tools for creating complex animations through a graphical interface of interconnected nodes. The system supports various animation techniques including procedural generation, deformation, and particle systems.

repos.name: anki_generator
repos.summary: Generates high-quality Anki flashcards from PDFs, DOCX files, and YouTube transcripts using Google Gemini AI. It creates structured questions and answers with optional TTS voice synthesis for audio pronunciation, exports to offline .apkg files or AnkiConnect integration, and supports both interactive and scriptable CLI modes.

repos.name: Anthropic-Cybersecurity-Skills
repos.summary: Provides a structured cybersecurity skills library with 818 production-grade skills mapped to 6 frameworks including MITRE ATT&CK, NIST CSF 2.0, MITRE ATLAS, D3FEND, and NIST AI RMF. It offers domain-specific capabilities for AI agents across 34 security domains and works with 26+ AI platforms following the agentskills.io standard.

repos.name: anthropic-sdk-typescript
repos.summary: The Claude SDK for TypeScript provides access to Anthropic's safety-first language model APIs from server-side TypeScript or JavaScript applications. It enables developers to interact with Claude models such as claude-opus-4-6 for creating messages and handling responses. The SDK supports multiple runtimes including Node.js, Deno, Bun, and Cloudflare Workers.

repos.name: antigravity-sdk-python
repos.summary: A Python library for building AI agents that leverage Google Antigravity and Gemini, providing a secure, scalable, and stateful infrastructure layer that abstracts the agentic loop. It supports multimodal ingestion, custom tools, MCP integration, hooks, policies, and triggers while offering both simple and advanced usage patterns including streaming responses and interactive loops.

repos.name: AntigravityQuotaWatcher
repos.summary: Antigravity Quota Watcher is a VS Code plugin that monitors and displays AI model quota usage in real-time on the status bar, with features like smart alerts, automatic detection of Antigravity service ports, and dashboard visualization of quota details.

repos.name: any-company-llm
repos.summary: AnyCloudLLM scans host hardware to select and download appropriate GGUF models, then serves them via an OpenAI-compatible API on localhost without cloud dependency. It provides both a chat UI and API endpoints for local LLM inference.

repos.name: anything-llm
repos.summary: AnythingLLM is a local-first AI application that enables users to chat with documents, automate workflows with AI agents, and manage private LLM instances without setup friction. It supports multiple LLMs, embedders, vector databases, and offers features like dynamic model routing, scheduled tasks, and multi-user support.

repos.name: anythingllm-embed
repos.summary: The AnythingLLM Embed widget is a submodule that enables embedding a workspace and its knowledge base as a chat bubble via script or iframe tags. It provides a public-facing interface for interacting with an AnythingLLM instance through customizable chat widgets. The widget supports session management, security features like random session IDs, and various customization options for appearance and behavior.

repos.name: anythingllm-mobile
repos.summary: AnythingLLM Mobile brings local AI intelligence to Android devices, enabling on-device language model inference, vision capabilities, speech-to-text, and tool integration without requiring internet connectivity. It supports downloading and running GGUF models directly on the phone and can connect to self-hosted AnythingLLM instances or various cloud providers.

repos.name: AnyTool
repos.summary: AnyTool provides a universal tool-use layer that enables AI agents to efficiently and reliably interact with diverse tools through intelligent orchestration. It offers fast tool retrieval, scalable tool management, and universal automation capabilities across web APIs, system operations, and GUI interactions.

repos.name: api-cli
repos.summary: The Hostinger API CLI provides a command-line interface to interact with the Hostinger API for managing hosting services. It allows users to perform operations such as listing billing catalogs, managing virtual machines, and handling DNS records through structured commands.
